info.name: PFEBSIT002 Equipment Borrowing - Week 15 baseline
info.description: Week 15 chunk 1. Expected results are written in each request's description BEFORE the run. Tests assert the desired behavior, so weaknesses show as failed tests on the unmodified code. Needs the environment `Equipment Borrowing (local HTTPS)` and `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`. No token, key or password is stored in this file.
